chief_complaint.description: The presenting complaint as stated by the referring system (TASK-981 e2e, tenant-admin authored).

department_code.description: Department code as registered in HOPE (GEN, BREN, …).

kinds.description: What the client states about this encounter at open: who, where, which visit, and its external id.

recordedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the observation set.

kinds.description: Observations recorded before the consultation, normalised. All properties optional; send what you have.

kinds.label: Previous Case Notes
kinds.description: The patient's prior case notes, supplied by the client at open; each entry is also materialized as a CASE_NOTE context item.

kinds.label: Work Note
kinds.description: The clinician's own working notes for this consultation.

kinds.label: Case Note
kinds.description: Clinical case notes contributed during or around the consultation (kept from consultation_note_context so a client naming kindKey case_note stays valid).

kinds.label: Attachment
kinds.description: A document attached to the consultation; its text is extracted before use.

kinds.label: Consultation Prompt Context

visit_type.description: Whether this is a new / referral visit or a follow-up (revisit).

attachments.description: Text extracted from the consultation attachments.

safe_vitals.description: Recorded vitals, or `Not available` — the v1 name of `formatted_vitals`.

ner_entities.description: Medical entities extracted from the transcript, serialised; empty when none.

dna_style_text.description: The doctor's resolved DNA writing style.

chief_complaint.description: The presenting complaint, when the client supplies one.

clinician_notes.description: The clinician's own working notes for this consultation.

formatted_vitals.description: Recorded vitals as text, or `Not available`.

pre_summary_text.description: The pre-summary this generation builds on.

doctor_highlights.description: Passages the clinician highlighted during the consultation.

current_department.description: The consultation's department name; `General` when unknown.

prior_visit_summary.description: The carried summary of the patient's previous visit, bounded.

conversation_language.description: The consultation language code (`en`, `ml`) — the v1 name of `language`.

formatted_test_results.description: Test results as text; empty when none.

formatted_previous_visits.description: Previous-visit summaries as text; empty when none.
